summary: Michael Girard posted the Dark decklists of the top six players at the 2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam: James Lafferty, Ryan Schueller, Kyle Craft, Tim Guzman, Eric Bruen and Ben VanBusKirk.
notes: Not an account of his own games: Girard posts the full lists of the top six decks, so games [] and no finish. He did play the event (Dan Christy, d736, beat his 'Vegas style' deck in round 6), so author_played true.
Order of the lists (Lafferty, Schueller, Craft, Guzman, Bruin, Van Buskirk) matches the TD's 1st–6th (d722); finishes recorded as 'Top 6' since Girard doesn't number them.
Name mapping: 'Eric Bruin' -> [[Eric Bruen]]; 'Ben Van Buskirk' -> [[Ben VanBusKirk]]; 'Ryan Schueller'/'Schuller' -> [[Ryan Schueller]].
Full decklists are in the body (not dested).

Objectives: Lafferty and Van Buskirk ISB Operations (both lists are nearly the same ISB deck); Schueller and Guzman Hunt Down (original HDADTJ, 2000); Craft Endor Operations (with Ominous Rumors, matching his own d705 'Endor Ops'). Bruen's TIE Scout deck has no objective (matches Garrison's d724 'TIE Scout Deck').
Guzman's Dark list corresponds to his posted deck page (Info Broker's Vegas Grand Slam DS); set as deck_page on his entry.
